crashes.collision_id: unique identifier for each reported traffic collision
crashes.crash_date: date when the traffic collision occurred
crashes.crash_time: time when the traffic collision occurred
crashes.borough: borough where the traffic collision occurred
crashes.zip_code: postal code of the location where the collision occurred
crashes.latitude: geographic latitude of the collision location
crashes.longitude: geographic longitude of the collision location
crashes.on_street_name: name of the street where the collision occurred
crashes.cross_street_name: name of the intersecting street near the collision
crashes.number_of_persons_injured: total number of people injured in the collision
crashes.number_of_persons_killed: total number of people killed in the collision
crashes.number_of_pedestrians_injured: number of pedestrians injured in the collision
crashes.number_of_pedestrians_killed: number of pedestrians killed in the collision
crashes.number_of_cyclist_injured: number of cyclists injured in the collision
crashes.number_of_cyclist_killed: number of cyclists killed in the collision
crashes.number_of_motorist_injured: number of motorists injured in the collision
crashes.number_of_motorist_killed: number of motorists killed in the collision
crashes.contributing_factor_vehicle_1: primary contributing factor for vehicle 1 in the collision
crashes.contributing_factor_vehicle_2: primary contributing factor for vehicle 2 in the collision
crashes.contributing_factor_vehicle_3: primary contributing factor for vehicle 3 in the collision
crashes.vehicle_type_code_1: type of vehicle 1 involved in the collision
crashes.vehicle_type_code_2: type of vehicle 2 involved in the collision
crashes.vehicle_type_code_3: type of vehicle 3 involved in the collision
